text:
Alex: Saturday dilemma — mini escape up the coast (Mendocino hike + bakery run) OR stay local and help @Maya at the town Comic Con indie alley? :thinking_face:
Maya: Comic Con for me! I scored a table in indie alley, need help with setup and carrying boxes. anyone down to carpool and be my muscle? :grin:
Devon: Mendocino sounds sweet. low-key hike, coffee, maybe fly kites if windy. perfect reset. :kite:
Samira: I can do Comic Con in the afternoon only (shifts). I’ll bring snacks and can cover Maya's table 3–4pm if someone can manage the morning. :purple_heart:
Alex: Logistics Qs — who’s driving for Mendocino? My car has room for 3, I’d leave ~8:30. If ComicCon wins we could meet at 10am by the north entrance.
Maya: I can bring a folding table and a big box of zines + pins. need a couple hands to lug the crate — @Devon? :pleading_face:
Devon: I can help lug stuff morning-of but not hang for the whole day. also can we do nature + comics next weekend and call it even? :eyes:
OpsBot: Heads-up: company picnic announced next month — calendar invite coming soon. :calendar:
Samira: Quick poll — react with :rocket: for Mendocino, :sparkles: for ComicCon, :coffee: to sleep in and recharge.
Alex: Cool. If Mendocino wins I’ll start a carpool thread and map out a schedule. Also shoutout to Maya for organizing the zine table — really cool. :clap:
Maya: Thanks!! Even if y’all can’t make it, I’ll mail stickers to volunteers. :heart:
Devon: :rocket:
Samira: :sparkles:
Alex: :rocket:
Maya: :sparkles:
